name: The Alchemist and the Slave
source:
You're an alchemist who can finally buy a goblin girl as a sex slave. That's all! The story will be about the everyday life of the two of you.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230307185516/https://little-huntress-team.itch.io/the-alchemist-and-the-slave]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一个炼金术士，终于可以买一个妖精女孩作为性奴隶。就这样！这个故事将讲述你们两个的日常生活。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230307185516/https://little-huntress-team.itch.io/the-alchemist-and-the-slave]Itch.io[/url]]
